description: Defines a sealed class 'DocEncoding' for PDF DocEncoding, extending System.Text.Encoding, implementing encoding conversions between WinAnsi and PDF DocEncoding, including byte and character count methods and a static byte mapping array.

classes.name: DocEncoding
classes.description: A sealed class for encoding PDF DocEncoding, extending System.Text.Encoding, providing methods for encoding conversions and byte/char count.

methods.name: GetByteCount
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to encode a set of characters using WinAnsi encoding.

methods.name: GetBytes
methods.description: Encodes characters into bytes using WinAnsi encoding and maps them to PDF DocEncoding.

methods.name: GetCharCount
methods.description: Returns the character count for a byte array, asserting consistency with WinAnsi encoding.

methods.name: GetChars
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to decode bytes into characters.

methods.name: GetMaxByteCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum byte count for a given character count.

methods.name: GetMaxCharCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum character count for a given byte count.
